texts: TL need before reoccupation (R = 193,243, 43.2% of the 2027–2050 need)
note: TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: all assumptions at full strength from 1 January 2027, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable); a thought experiment combining instant limits; its early years rely on re-occupying all vacant dwellings and a return to 1991 household size. In 2027 households re-form at the 1991 household size, so almost no new households form that year; released dwellings are brought back into use in proportion to each year's need; 2026 observed.
